description.en: Compact tawny and cream feathered body, modest short snout, broad spread feathered wings with separated outer primary tips, graduated fan of tail feathers. Small tucked paired feet. Quiet chest, warm brown flight feathers and cream coverts. No crest or long skeletal tail.
